_about: Meta primary text and headline for each of the 20 ads (4 Nov 2026). Every claim is on the live site or the product page today: the Buy 2 / Buy 3 automatic discount, free insured shipping, insured delivery in 3-5 working days, cash on delivery on serviceable pincodes, the Naira gift box, the adjustable US 5-9 rings, the live prices. Colours are named as colours, never as gems; metals as gold tone or silver tone. CTA for all: Shop now.
